name: Johnny Glover
reason: No published European base: jgyoga.co.uk (home, About, Contact, Online resources) and his Samye Ling tutor page give only a mobile number, Zoom classes and Samye Ling (a retreat venue, not his base) and name no town where he lives or teaches in person. The content is also thin once rules are applied: Zoom classes with no pages of their own, invite-only online retreats, one fully booked Samye Ling weekend (27-30 Nov 2026) and a £30 subscription of recorded practices, with no YouTube channel or books (his one album is handpan music). His email johnny@jgyoga.co.uk is published on his home page if he is revisited.
